qa_pairs.question: What are the benefits of using a newer C++ compiler and C++ standards?
qa_pairs.answer: Using a newer compiler and standards with C++ code allows for taking full advantage of optimizations resulting from features like `constexpr`, and updates to existing definitions improve code correctness and enable more optimizations.

qa_pairs.question: What is the consequence of using an older C++ compiler or standard when newer options are available?
qa_pairs.answer: Using an old compiler and/or an older standard when newer ones can be used will prevent you from taking advantage of newer compiler abilities and C++ definitions.
